2609.11209.title: REVA: Reusable Evidence View Aggregation for Context-Efficient RAG Serving
2609.11209.paper_summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) improves knowledge-intensive large language model (LLM) applications by conditioning generation on retrieved documents, but longer contexts increase latency, key-value (KV) cache memory, and token cost. Post-retrieval compression can reduce this cost, yet existing compressors often operate independently for each query, rely on auxiliary models or rewriting, and introduce online overhead that can offset the benefit of shorter prompts. We revisit RAG compression from a data-mining perspective by aggregating historical query--document--model interactions into reusable evidence views. We first show that modern compressors have unstable gains over simple truncation and can add substantial inference-time latency. We then propose Reusable Evidence View Aggregation (REVA), a framework that mines the target generator's historical attention traces into a document-keyed, budget-agnostic score store. REVA maps token-level attention to readable word units, aggregates importance across repeated document accesses, and renders budget-specific plain-text views that preserve document order and the standard RAG interface. Across four representative benchmarks and modern LLMs, REVA improves generation quality by 1.0--5.8 points over existing advances, while reducing compression overhead by a factor of 5.3 to 15.6, adding less than 40 ms of latency.
2609.11209.paper_summary_zh: 檢索增強生成（RAG）透過依賴檢索到的文檔來改善知識密集型大型語言模型（LLM）應用，但較長的上下文會增加延遲、鍵值（KV）快取記憶體和標記成本。後檢索壓縮可以減少這一成本，但現有的壓縮器通常對每個查詢獨立運作，依賴輔助模型或重寫，並引入在線開銷，這可能抵消較短提示的好處。我們從數據挖掘的角度重新審視RAG壓縮，通過將歷史查詢-文檔-模型互動聚合成可重用的證據視圖。我們首先顯示現代壓縮器在簡單截斷上具有不穩定的增益，並可能增加相當大的推理時間延遲。然後，我們提出可重用證據視圖聚合（REVA），這是一個將目標生成器的歷史注意力痕跡挖掘到文檔鍵控、預算無關的分數存儲庫的框架。REVA將標記級注意力映射到可讀的單詞單位，聚合重複文檔訪問的重點，並呈現保持文檔順序和標準RAG介面的預算特定純文本視圖。在四個代表性基準和現代LLM中，REVA在現有進展的基礎上提高了生成質量1.0-5.8點，同時將壓縮開銷減少了5.3到15.6倍，增加的延遲少於40毫秒。
